title: Up hole electric heating melting core taking drilling system used for surrounding ice core at bottom of ice shelf
assignee: JILIN UNIVERSITY; 吉林大学
abstract_original: The invention discloses an up hole electric heating melting core taking drilling system used for a surrounding ice core at the bottom of an ice shelf. The up hole electric heating melting core takingdrilling system comprises an underwater submersible device, a heat melting core taking drill, a power cabinet and a control system. The heat melting core taking drill is assembled on the top of the underwater submersible device through a linking seat. The power cabinet and the control system are arranged in an inner cavity of the underwater submersible device. The power cabinet is connected with the heat melting core taking drill through a cable. The power cabinet provides electric power for the heat melting core taking drill. The cable is wound around a rope winding device. The control systemis connected with the power cabinet and the heat melting core taking drill, and the control system controls the heat melting core taking drill to work. The up hole electric heating melting core taking drilling system has the beneficial effects that the structural design of the drill is unique, the principle is clear, the surrounding ice core can automatically climb while drilling is conducted, uphole drilling is conducted in the bottom of the polar ice shelf from bottom to top, and core taking drilling and observation study are conducted on the ice layer at the bottom of the ice shelf. The underwater submersible device can be helped to rapidly drill the ice shelf, a buoy is thrown, and the communication capability of the submersible device is improved.

title: Ice crystal melting rate measuring system and method
assignee: XIAN JIAOTONG UNIVERSITY; 西安交通大学
abstract_original: The invention discloses a system and a method for measuring the melting rate of ice crystals, which are used for calculating the melting rate of ice crystals with different particle sizes in the melting process. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an ice crystal picture; reading an original image of the ice crystal image; copying an original image; performing median filtering and noise reduction; converting into a grey-scale map; automatically identifying a circular area; deleting the background outside the circular area; carrying out adaptive histogram equalization; carrying out self-adaptive local threshold binarization; drawing an ice core outline by the magnetic lasso; and calculating the ice crystal melting rate through the ice crystal melting rate equivalent model. The method belongs to direct measurement, the ice-water phase interface is directly identified through an image, and the melting rate is calculated. And meanwhile, a surface tension suspension method is adopted for a melting experiment, so that vibration or overturning of ice crystal particles caused by external environment influence is greatly reduced, and a measurement result is more stable.

title: DEVICE FOR PROVIDING TESTING OF MEDIUM-SIZED SAMPLES OF LABORATORY SEA ICE IN AN ICE BASIN
abstract_original:
FIELD: test equipment.
SUBSTANCE: invention relates to experimental studies of the effect of ice on marine structures, concerns the provision of laboratory sea-ice samples preparation and testing and solves the task of providing significant reduction of labor and energy costs when preparing medium-sized samples of laboratory sea ice and conducting a series of its experimental studies and criteria of destruction. For this purpose, in the device for preparation of medium-scale samples of laboratory sea ice and conducting a series of experimental studies of its properties and criteria of destruction, including a closed room with a reservoir located in it, filled with sea water, which is frozen for ice preparation, and equipped with a cooling and ventilation system and a fine spraying nozzle connected to the fresh water source, providing adjustment of ice crystallization nuclei size, according to the invention, the reservoir for filling with sea water is made in the form of a reservoir made of stainless steel elongated mainly rectangular in the plan view, the length and width of which are determined by the transverse size and the required quantity of ice medium-scale samples, extracted from sea ice prepared in vessel under conditions of distribution of samples on tank surface so that distance from tank side to central axis of extracted sea ice samples, as well as between central axes of sea ice samples themselves is at least two transverse dimensions of sample. Height of the reservoir should be such that the water is filled with water at a depth which is 2 times greater than the thickness of the ice frozen in it. At the same time along the long side the reservoir is divided by a vertical partition fixed on its sides into two sections at ratio of 4:1, the larger of which is intended for freezing of laboratory ice, and smaller – for filling it with water to compensate for pressure during freezing of ice and preventing occurrence of internal stresses in ice. At that, the vertical partition is installed so that in the upper part of the reservoir there provided is non-transfer of water from the large section into the small one, and in the lower part – there was a gap between the lower end of the partition and the tank bottom, which is necessary for free movement of water between the sections. Surface of the reservoir, including the upper horizontal surface of the small section, is covered on the outer side with a heat-insulating layer of heat-insulating material located at distance from the walls of the reservoir by value from 5 to 10 cm, in the lumen between which a heating cable is laid. Besides, the heating cable is laid in the form of a snake or a spiral. Experience of using the proposed device for ensuring the performance of tests of medium-scale samples of laboratory sea ice has confirmed the expected characteristics and physical and mechanical properties of freezing ice, as well as suitability for analyzing strength properties and criteria of destruction.
EFFECT: disclosed is a device for providing testing of medium-sized samples of laboratory sea ice in an ice basin.

title: Device for continuously extracting ice core gas and synchronously collecting water body and use method
assignee: INSTITUTE OF TIBETAN PLATEAU RESEARCH, CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES; 中国科学院青藏高原研究所
abstract_original: The invention discloses a device for continuously extracting ice core gas and synchronously collecting water and a using method. The device comprises a sample containing shell, a sample pushing mechanism is installed at the closed end of the sample containing shell, a transparent sealing cover is installed at the open end of the sample containing shell, and an ice melting component is installed in the sealing cover. The sample sealing sleeve comprises a transparent soft sleeve, the closed end of the soft sleeve is arranged in the sample containing shell and connected with a sample pushing mechanism penetrating through the closed end of the sample containing shell, and the open end of the soft sleeve extends out. After the sealing cover is buckled with the sample containing shell, the part, located in the sample containing shell, of the soft sleeve and the sealing cover form a sealing cavity for containing the ice core. And the ice core is pushed by the sample pushing mechanism to move towards the ice melting part so as to be melted by the ice melting part. The sample accommodating shell and the sealing cover are provided with a purging pipe, the sealing cover is provided with a gas sampling pipe and a drainage pipe, and the drainage pipe is connected with a water body collecting component. According to the invention, continuous extraction of gas samples and synchronous collection of water samples are realized for the whole ice core.

title: Laser coring drilling method and drilling apparatus for ice layer probing
assignee: JILIN UNIVERSITY; 吉林大学
abstract_original: The invention discloses a laser coring drilling method and drilling apparatus for ice layer probing. The laser coring drilling method is a physical icebreaking method of non-mechanical contact type, specifically, a high energy laser beam is used to perform direct action on an ice surface and a local ice surface is heated rapidly to melt. The laser coring drilling method comprises the steps that with the rotation of a laser probe, the laser beam is directly contacted with an ice layer, an annular gap can be formed, a drilling rod is smoothly transferred to a lower level, after the drilling of around trip is finished, ice core cutting devices are used for cutting an ice core under the cooperation of steel wire ropes, and the ice core is taken to the ground surface, so that following work ofice detection and analysis is convenient to finish. The complicated process of mechanical drilling is omitted by using a laser high-energy ice-melt method, and the pollution to polar region environment is reduced without drilling fluid, bit freezing accidents are avoided, and meanwhile, the influence caused in the process of hot water drilling on the ice core shape is further avoided, and the laser coring drilling method is extremely clean ice core original shape keeping drilling method. The laser drilling method further ensures the verticality of drilling holes, an inclined hole is not generated, and the drilling apparatus is used for realizing the method.

title: Ice layer coring device and method
assignee: CHINA UNIVERSITY OF PETROLEUM, BEIJING; 中国石油大学（北京）
abstract_original: The invention relates to the field of ice layer drilling, and discloses an ice layer coring device and method. The ice layer coring device comprises a hollow drill rod, a drill bit body and an ice core breaking assembly, a first protrusion and a second protrusion are arranged, and the first protrusion and the second protrusion are oppositely arranged on the inner side of the pipe wall of the hollow drill rod above the drill bit body in a vertically spaced mode. The ice layer coring method comprises the steps that coring operation is conducted, specifically, a drill bit body is started to rotate, and meanwhile drilling fluid is pumped into a pipe cavity of a hollow drill rod; the density of the drilling fluid is greater than that of the ice core; core cutting operation is conducted, the ice core moves upwards along a pipe cavity of the hollow drill rod, a pair of opposite acting force in the radial direction of the ice core is generated on the ice core through a first protrusion and a second protrusion, and the ice core is broken into a plurality of sections according to the preset length; and core outlet operation is conducted, the multiple sections of ice cores float upwards to the top opening of the hollow drill rod one by one under the action of buoyancy, and a tool is used for bailing the ice cores. The coring device is used for solving the ice layer coring problem, and the effects of being easy to operate, high in coring efficiency and good in ice core quality are achieved.

abstract_original: A method for planning the gait of an ultra-large polar region scientific investigation vehicle having six crawler feet when crossing a snowbank, comprising the following steps: step 1, when a distance measuring sensor on a scientific investigation vehicle detects that a snowbank is present at the front, six crawler feet (6) all stop advancing, the whole scientific investigation vehicle remains still, and preparation for a snowbank crossing action is started; step 2, legs (3) are unfolded; step 3, the vehicle advances to cross the snowbank; and step 4, the legs (3) are withdrawn. assignee: TAIYUAN UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY; 太原科技大学; TAIYUAN UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY; 太原理工大学; POLAR RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA; 中国极地研究中心
abstract_original: The invention relates to an ice crack crossing gait planning method for a giant six-leg crawler belt  foot polar region scientific investigation vehicle. The method comprises an ice crack-crossing preparation gait, an ice crack-crossing advancing gait and an ice crack-crossing recovery gait. The ice crack-crossing preparation gait comprises nine sequential decomposition actions including overall forward moving, left middle limb leg crawler foot and right middle limb leg crawler foot rotary supporting, left front limb leg crawler foot adduction, right front limb leg crawler foot adduction and the like. The ice crack-crossing advancing gait comprises 11 sequential decomposition actions including outward swinging of a right front limb leg crawler foot, outward swinging of a left front limb leg crawler foot, overall forward moving, lateral swinging of a right middle limb leg crawler foot, lateral swinging of a left middle limb leg crawler foot, inward swinging of a right rear limb leg crawler foot, inward swinging of a left rear limb leg crawler foot and the like. The ice crack-crossing recovery gait comprises three sequential decomposition actions of overall forward movement, oppositefolding of the left rear limb leg crawler foot and the right rear limb leg crawler foot and the like. The giant six-leg crawler belt  foot polar region scientific investigation vehicle can cross icecracks, and personnel and vehicle safety accidents are avoided.

abstract_original: The invention discloses a north pole sea ice prediction method based on a space attention mechanism deep network, and the method comprises the steps: inputting to-be-detected sea ice data into each north pole sea ice prediction model, carrying out the temperature scaling of the probability distribution of the north pole sea ice concentration level through different temperature coefficients, and carrying out the average integration according to corresponding months, and finally, selecting a maximum probability value in the probability distribution mean values after average integration, and outputting an arctic sea ice concentration data classification result corresponding to the maximum probability value to complete arctic sea ice prediction. According to the method, a grid-based gating attention mechanism is added in the U-Net model, activation of an irrelevant region is inhibited, activation of a region related to a task is enhanced, an attention coefficient is made to be specific to a local region, and then the long-term prediction capacity of the model is effectively improved. The north pole sea ice prediction model provided by the invention can more accurately predict the appearance range of the sea ice, and can maintain better performance in an extreme sea ice event.

title: Sea ice roughness inversion method based on ensemble learning method and two-dimensional wavelet transform
assignee: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY; 南京信息工程大学
abstract_original: The invention provides a sea ice roughness inversion method based on an ensemble learning method and two-dimensional wavelet transform, and the method comprises the steps: extracting the spatial features of sea ice from an SAR image containing sea ice in a target time period in a target region through two-dimensional continuous wavelet transform; then obtaining actual sea ice roughness through all footprint point data in a target time period in the target area, and spatially matching SAR image original information and sea ice spatial features in the target time period in the target area with the corresponding actual sea ice roughness to construct a total data set; and finally, taking the SAR image original information and the sea ice spatial features as input, and taking the corresponding sea ice predicted roughness as output to train the integrated learning model, and obtaining a sea ice roughness inversion model based on the integrated learning method. According to the method, the problems of large sea ice roughness inversion error and low resolution in the prior art can be effectively solved.

title: Deep learning-based north pole sea ice concentration prediction method
assignee: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY; 南京信息工程大学
abstract_original: The invention discloses a deep learning-based north pole sea ice concentration prediction method, which specifically comprises the following steps of: 1, acquiring north pole sea ice concentration data and ERA5 meteorological factor data; step 2, preprocessing the meteorological factor data, step 3, splicing the north pole sea ice concentration data and the meteorological factor data at the same moment on a channel dimension to obtain multi-source fusion data; 4, dividing the multi-source fusion data in the step 3 into n groups according to time, and establishing a feature extraction network; the feature extraction network comprises n feature extraction modules, 5, inputting the nth multi-source fusion data set into the nth feature extraction module of the feature extraction network, and extracting the spatial-temporal features of the multi-source fusion data set, and 6, inputting the output of the feature extraction network into the adaptive weight distribution network, and obtaining a sea ice concentration predicted value. According to the method, the problem that the attention of a traditional time sequence prediction model is focused at the tail end is solved, and the prediction accuracy is effectively improved.

title: Arctic sea ice prediction method based on multi-scale graph neural network and conservation law
assignee: UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY OF CHINA; 中国科学技术大学
abstract_original: The invention discloses an arctic sea ice prediction method based on a multi-scale map neural network and a conservation law, and the method comprises the steps: selecting earth surface, ocean and atmosphere variable data, carrying out the grid division of an arctic region according to different spatial resolutions, and constructing a multi-scale map; updating the feature of each node in the graph, and integrating the spatial information of different scale graphs to obtain a sea ice density prediction model; adding a humidity conservation term and a potential vorticity conservation term into a loss function of the sea ice density prediction model, constructing a composite loss function, and ensuring that the model follows the physical conservation law of humidity and potential vorticity in the prediction process; and training the sea ice density prediction model by using historical data and the composite loss function, and predicting the future sea ice state by using daily updated data and the trained model. According to the method, the precision and efficiency of sea ice density prediction are remarkably improved, and a scientific basis is provided for climate change research, resource development and shipping route planning.

title: METHOD FOR MONITORING ICE CONDITIONS AND SYSTEM FOR MONITORING ICE CONDITIONS
abstract_original:
FIELD: hydrometeorology.

title: Floating type anti-icing device suitable for drilling platform
assignee: JIANGSU UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY; 江苏科技大学
abstract_original: The invention relates to a floating type anti-icing device suitable for a drilling platform. The floating type anti-icing device is composed of a plurality of icebreaking units which float on a sea surface and surround the drilling platform and are sequentially connected end to end. An icebreaking unit is mainly composed of a floating body. The floating body comprises an ice facing plate, an ice backing plate, a first side plate, a second side plate and first icebreaking strips. The ice facing plate, the ice backing plate, the first side plate and the second side plate are welded into a whole and jointly enclose to form a closed cavity. The ice facing plate is used for bearing the first icebreaking strip, is in a bow shape on the whole and is formed by sequentially connecting a lower arc-shaped bent section, a lower smooth transition section, a middle outer arch ridge section, an upper smooth transition section and an upper arc-shaped bent section. A plurality of first ice breaking strips are linearly and evenly distributed in the width direction of the ice facing plate. According to the floating type anti-icing device suitable for the drilling platform, in this way, floating ice on the sea surface can be effectively prevented from rushing to the drilling platform, and then the phenomenon that supporting stand columns are damaged due to the floating impact force effect is avoided.

title: Arctic region module enclosure structure optimization method
assignee: BOMESC OFFSHORE ENGINEERING COMPANY LIMITED; 博迈科海洋工程股份有限公司
abstract_original: The invention discloses an optimization method for a module enclosure structure in an arctic region. The method comprises the following steps: collecting types of thermal insulation materials currently applied to the module enclosure structure in the arctic region; counting and establishing an arithmetic progression of the thermal insulation material thickness of the enclosure structure and an arithmetic progression of the thermal insulation window width; the thermal insulation material thickness arithmetic progression and the thermal insulation window width arithmetic progression are combined to form various size schemes; different size schemes are combined with thermal insulation materials to form various structure schemes; heating energy consumption corresponding to different structure schemes is calculated through energy consumption analysis; solving the function relationship between the heating energy consumption corresponding to each structure scheme and the thickness of the heat-insulating material and the width of the heat-insulating window; and the scheme with the lowest heating energy consumption in all the structure schemes serves as the optimal scheme. Compared with a traditional scheme, the building envelope can be comprehensively optimized, and heating energy consumption in the using process of the module in the north pole region is reduced.

title: Method for using device for sea ice desalination by using unpowered ventilation
assignee: DU WENJUAN; 杜文娟
abstract_original: A method for using a device for sea ice desalination by using unpowered ventilation is provided. The method is characterized in that a circular frame and an exhaust pipe provided with an arc-shaped hood are arranged in the center of a desalination tank; an air feeder is arranged on the edge of the circular frame; a thermal insulation layer covers the circular frame; sea ice to be subjected to desalination is arranged in the circular frame; air flows through the arc-shaped hood, the flow velocity increases, the pressure decreases, and air under the thermal insulation layer is sucked up; on theother hand, external air flows from the air feeder to the sea ice under the thermal insulation layer to control the temperature and exhaust brine. A low-salinity brine tank and a distillation tank areset next to the desalination tank, and generated distilled water is used to dilute the brine in the low-salinity tank with a salinity of 0.1% to 0.13%, converting the brine into freshwater. An automatic ventilation mechanism is arranged, and can automatically increase the number of times of ventilation according to the ambient temperature. A beneficial effect is that unpowered ventilation is adopted, omitting ventilation equipment and power consumption. The produced distilled water is used to dilute brine with a salinity of 0.1% to 0.13% and waste water of the prior art is converted into freshwater.

assignee: SHANDONG OCEAN CHEMICAL INDUSTRY SCIENTIFIC RESEARCH INSTITUTE; 山东省海洋化工科学研究院
abstract_original: The invention discloses a preparation method of a self-cleaning polar region marine antifouling paint, which comprises the following steps: fully stirring and mixing mesoporous titanium dioxide nanoparticles and Bi (NO3) 3.5 H2O, reacting with KI to prepare ball-flower-shaped BiOI/TiO2, carrying out surface treatment on the ball-flower-shaped BiOI/TiO2 by using a silane coupling agent, then pouring vinyl silicone oil, and carrying out vacuum drying to obtain the self-cleaning polar region marine antifouling paint. And then adding the mixture into polar antifouling resin for dispersion treatment to obtain a target product. assignee: DALIAN MARITIME UNIVERSITY; 大连海事大学
abstract_original: The utility model discloses an ice-resistant buoy suitable for oil spill monitoring of polar regions and frozen sea areas. abstract_original: The invention discloses an electric heat tracing self-adaptive system control method for an oil and gas pipeline in a polar region. title: METHOD OF ICE COVER DESTRUCTION
abstract_original:
FIELD: vessels and other watercrafts.
SUBSTANCE: invention relates to ice-technical equipment, particularly to performance of icebreaking works by air-cushion ships. Disclosed is method of ice cover destruction, which consists in progressive simultaneous movement of two vessels along sinusoidal trajectories, which are shifted relative to each other by half of sine wave length and have amplitude, sufficient for excitation of resonant flexural-gravity waves (FGW) of maximum height at approach of vessels to minimum safe distance. Projections of velocities for both longitudinal and transverse directions of ship movement should be equal to speed of resonant FGWs.
EFFECT: high efficiency of ice cover destruction is achieved by interference of resonant FGWs excited by two vessels moving both in longitudinal and transverse directions at resonant speed.
1 cl, 3 dwg

title: Semi-submersible polar region research ship
assignee: WUHAN UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY; 武汉理工大学
abstract_original: The invention relates to the technical field of ships and in particular to a semi-submersible polar region research ship which comprises a ship body, wherein an icebreaking blade is arranged on the bow of the ship body; a water ballast tank is arranged in the bottom of the ship body; a superstructure is arranged on the upper portion of the ship body; a ship body design waterline is arranged between the superstructure and the bottom of the ship body; and a milling cutter module with an adjustable inclination angle and a propeller are arranged on the stern of the ship body. According to such a structural arrangement, the ice breaking blade is used for directly breaking a thinner ice layer, the water ballast tank is used for increasing ballast water to draft the ship body, the milling cuttermodule is used for thinning a thick ice layer and then breaking the ice layer, and the propeller is used for providing propelling force for the ship body. The semi-submersible polar region research ship has the stem-stern two-way icebreaking capacity, the ship body can break the thicker ice layer through the combined icebreaking mode, and meanwhile a safety guarantee is provided for icebreaking operation of a ship.

abstract_original: The utility model provides a continuous icebreaking mechanism with rotatable cutting teeth. The continuous icebreaking mechanism comprises a rotating wheel, a rotating wheel shaft, a rotating wheel support, a bearing rotating joint, a rotating cutting head, a protective sleeve, a base and a motor. Wherein the runner is connected with the bearing rotary joint, and the runner bracket is responsiblefor supporting the whole structure. The rotating wheel support is fixed to the hull and drives the rotating wheel shaft to rotate through the power source so as to drive the rotating wheel to rotate.The bearing rotating joint leads out a wire to supply power to a motor at the end of the rotating wheel to drive the rotating cutting head to rotate. Due to the fact that the bending strength of the ice layer is weak, the rotating rotating wheel and the rotating cutting head can generate destructive power on the ice layer, and therefore the ship body can break ice and advance. The continuous icebreaking mechanism with the rotatable cutting teeth is safe and efficient and does not damage a ship body.

title: Vibration resistance reduction amphibious planing boat suitable for polar region overlapped ice region
assignee: HARBIN ENGINEERING UNIVERSITY; 哈尔滨工程大学
abstract_original: The invention discloses a vibration resistance reduction amphibious planing boat suitable for a polar region overlapped ice region. The vibrators are arranged on the outer shell, when the planing boat sails on ice, the outer shell is driven by the vibrators to conduct high-frequency vibration at a specific frequency, adhesion of ice and snow to the boat body can be greatly reduced, ice and snow particles around the outer shell of the boat body can form an ice and snow particle agitation layer, the lubricating effect is achieved on the planing boat sailing on the ice layer, and the service life of the planing boat is prolonged. The resistance of the planing boat sailing on the ice surface can be obviously reduced; when the planing boat sails in water in an ice area, the high-frequency vibration outer shell can achieve vibration icebreaking. In addition, the flexible air cushion arranged between the inner shell and the outer shell is used for supporting and damping, vibration of the inner shell can be effectively reduced, and the influence of vibration of the outer shell on passengers in the cabin and other equipment is reduced. An air propeller thruster and a walking mechanism are adopted to control the sailing direction of the planing boat. The method is suitable for overlapped ice conditions with rugged surfaces, more crack defects and complex road conditions.

title: ICE BREAKING DEVICE
abstract_original:
FIELD: ice cover breaking.
SUBSTANCE: invention relates to means for breaking the ice cover. A device for the destruction of the ice cover is proposed, which is mounted on the bow of the nuclear icebreaker and determines the method for destruction of the ice cover area of ​​the ocean in front of the icebreaker with high pressure and high temperature steam from the steam generator of the nuclear icebreaker supplied through calibrated teeth located on the ribs of a pallet without a bottom located on a hinged fixed frame. The frame with the tray is made with the possibility of lowering the tray under the ice and lifting it until it touches the bottom surface of the ice, followed by steam supply through the teeth and lifting the tray up as the ice melts. After the melting of the ice area with the formation of ice fragments, determined by the number of ribs, the frame with the pallet is lowered down through the ice fragments. The nuclear-powered icebreaker begins forward movement, crushing ice fragments that pass between the branches of the frame. After the icebreaker reaches the undisturbed area of ​​ice, the destruction cycle is repeated.
EFFECT: use of the proposed device increases the speed of the forward movement of the icebreaker, which also determines the increase in the speed of the ships following it.

abstract_original: The invention provides a continuous icebreaking mechanism with rotatable cutting teeth. abstract_original: The invention designs a combined bubble-assisted ice breaking and deicing system, which is applied to the ice breaking field of ships. title: Novel hovercraft ice breaking device and method thereof
assignee: HARBIN ENGINEERING UNIVERSITY; 哈尔滨工程大学
abstract_original: The invention relates to a novel hovercraft ice breaking device and a method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of ice breaking. As that electromagnetic induction principle is utilize, a high-energy electromagnetic inductor is adopted in the induction heating ice breaking system, At the same time, the main engine of the ice breaker drives the icebreaker to rotate, and the ice breaker breaks the ice surface rapidly through mechanical collision and thermal effect in the process of contacting with the ice. After combining with the technology of the air cushion vehicle, there are three ice breaker modes to cause the ice layer damage. A noise compensation method of transfer alignment deflection deformation in a polar region environment is designed by combining a navigation error equation with a Greenwich meridian as a heading reference line in a grid coordinate system. abstract_original: The invention belongs to the field of navigation, discloses a dual inertial navigation collaborative calibration method in a polar region environment, and is suitable for autonomous calibration of a carrier equipped with multiple inertial navigation systems with indexing mechanisms in a polar region. title: Impulse noise suppression method for underwater acoustic OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) communication in polar region ice
assignee: HARBIN ENGINEERING UNIVERSITY; 哈尔滨工程大学
abstract_original: The invention aims to provide an impulse noise suppression method for underwater acoustic OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) communication in polar region ice, which comprises the following steps of: performing channel estimation and equalization on a passband receiving signal based on a least square criterion by using an OFDM pilot frequency subcarrier so as to estimate background noise. And meanwhile, pulse noise position information is obtained only by using the estimated value, and pulse noise is detected and marked by using a 3sigma principle based on a generalized signal-to-noise ratio. And after the impulse noise is suppressed by using the adaptive median filter, adding the noise estimation value to the noise-free receiving signal to obtain a passband receiving signal subjected to impulse noise suppression processing. And then carrying out subsequent channel estimation, channel equalization and judgment processes, and finally decoding to obtain information source information. According to the invention, the interference of the OFDM signal on the pulse detection process is effectively avoided; according to the 3sigma pulse noise detection method based on the generalized signal-to-noise ratio, a detection threshold value which can be adaptively adjusted according to pulse noise is realized. The operand of the algorithm is reduced through the impulse noise suppression step.

abstract_original: The invention provides an improved D * Lite polar region ship dynamic path planning method, and the method specifically comprises the steps: S1, constructing a grid environment map, and calculating a comprehensive navigation risk value RIO of each grid; s2, carrying out grid classification and introducing a safety coefficient omega; s3, nodes and node variables in a D * lite algorithm are introduced into the grid environment map, and an edge cost function c (s, s') and a cost function rhs (s) are improved; s4, expanding the neighborhood search direction of the node into 32 neighborhoods; s5, minimizing the cost function rhs' (s) to obtain an optimal path; s6, re-planning a path; according to the method, the characteristic and rule that the sea ice risk value continuously changes in actual navigation are fully utilized, path planning and the ship comprehensive navigation risk value are combined, the method better fits the actual navigation path, meanwhile, the path length, the path smoothness and the path safety are optimized, and higher implementability and adaptability are achieved.

title: Novel self-adaptive polar navigation ship resistance reduction system
assignee: JIANGSU UNIVERSITY OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY; 江苏科技大学
abstract_original: The invention mainly relates to the field of ship design and ship construction, and particularly discloses a novel self-adaptive polar navigation ship resistance reduction system. The novel self-adaptive polar navigation ship resistance reduction system comprises a streamlined resistance reduction mechanism, a supporting mechanism, a monitoring device and a terminal control system, the streamlinedresistance reduction mechanism is arranged on the supporting mechanism, the supporting mechanism is arranged on a ship body, the streamlined resistance reduction mechanism and the supporting mechanism are cooperated with each other to achieve the purposes of raising waves and changing a flow field, the monitoring device is installed on the ship body of the front side of the streamlined resistancereduction mechanism and is used for monitoring the flow condition and ice condition information, and the terminal control system is used for analyzing information and adjusting the attitude of the streamlined resistance reduction mechanism. The novel self-adaptive polar navigation ship resistance reduction system can guarantee excellent ice-discharging and ice-breaking performance of a polar navigation ship, and can further reduce total resistance of a ship during navigation in polar regions.

title: SINS/DVL polar region integrated navigation method and system under virtual sphere model
assignee: SOOCHOW UNIVERSITY; 苏州大学
abstract_original: The invention relates to an SINS/DVL polar region integrated navigation method and system under a virtual sphere model. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring real-time data acquired by an inertial sensor and an acoustic Doppler velocimeter; constructing inertial navigation mechanical arrangement under the virtual sphere model; constructing an SINS/DVL integrated positioning system error model under the virtual sphere model based on inertial navigation mechanical arrangement under the virtual sphere model; substituting real-time data into an SINS/DVL combined positioning system error model under the virtual sphere model, and realizing error parameter estimation by using an iterative optimization algorithm; and defining the long-endurance inertial navigation positioning duration of the polar region as M, if the navigation time k is less than M, determining that the calibration process is not completed, and repeating the steps until the navigation positioning is finished. The virtual sphere model is adopted for polar region inertial navigation updating, so that the algorithm complexity is reduced, and the inertial navigation positioning precision is improved.

title: High-latitude navigation data management and simulation method and equipment
assignee: HARBIN ENGINEERING UNIVERSITY; 哈尔滨工程大学
abstract_original: The invention discloses a high-latitude navigation data management and simulation method and equipment, belongs to the technical field of integrated navigation, and solves the problem that high-latitude navigation equipment data management and navigation algorithm simulation effect evaluation cannot be realized. According to the method, a distributed simulation structure is adopted, the structure is composed of a server side and a client side, and the server side and the client side are operated in a server side computer and a client side computer respectively. Actual measurement data are stored in a server-side computer in a standardized mode, data reading and navigation resolving are both carried out in server-side software, and a client-side computer only receives navigation resolving errors, visualizes the data and displays the data to common users in the forms of track diagrams and data discount diagrams, so that the purpose of data secrecy is achieved. On the basis of ship high-latitude navigation data, large-capacity high-latitude navigation measured data are read, processed, sent and visually displayed, meanwhile, a third-party dll algorithm file can be called, and the functions of high-latitude navigation equipment data management and navigation algorithm simulation effect evaluation are achieved.

title: Sea ice dense area cloud top height satellite inversion method based on cloud shadow information
assignee: OCEAN UNIVERSITY OF CHINA; 中国海洋大学
abstract_original: The invention discloses a sea ice dense region cloud top height satellite inversion method based on cloud shadow data. The method comprises the steps of identifying a clouded region by using MODIS cloud data; positioning a potential cloud shadow area through a dynamic threshold method; eliminating the possibility that a sea ice crack is identified as a cloud shadow by using MODIS brightness temperature data; eliminating the possibility that water is identified as the cloud shadow by using an NDWI index; only reserving a cloud shadow area with continuous space so as to remove independent pixel points which are far away from the area and are identified as the cloud shadow; calculating the cloud top height of the cloud edge point; calculating the cloud top height of the cloud center area by using the brightness temperature and the cloud top height of the cloud edge point; and combining the two heights to obtain the cloud top height of the sea ice dense area. According to the method, the characteristic that cloud in a sea ice dense area can project an obvious shadow on an underlying surface is fully utilized, the height of the cloud top of the Arctic Ocean is inverted by utilizing the width of the cloud shadow based on the cloud shadow effect, and the high uncertainty of a calculation result of the height of the cloud top of the Arctic Ocean caused by a temperature inversion method is overcome.

title: Polar region ship path planning method and system based on improved JPS algorithm
assignee: SHANGHAI SHIP AND SHIPPING RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO., LTD.; 上海船舶运输科学研究所有限公司; WUHAN UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY; 武汉理工大学; COSCO SHIPPING TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.; 中远海运科技股份有限公司
abstract_original: The invention provides a polar region ship path planning method and system based on an improved JPS algorithm, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the sea ice thickness data, sea ice density data and spatial data of all navigation regions of a polar region ship, and dividing a plurality of sea ice types according to the sea ice thickness data; obtaining a risk index value according to each sea ice type and the ice level of the polar region ship, calculating the ship passable values of all the navigation areas according to the risk index value and the sea ice density data, and calculating the navigation risk value of the navigation area according to the passable value of a certain navigation area and the calculated maximum passable value in all the navigation areas. And the problems of high calculation speed and optimal planning path can be simultaneously met.

title: Arctic navigation risk space-time evaluation and prediction method based on multi-source data driving
assignee: DALIAN MARITIME UNIVERSITY; 大连海事大学
abstract_original: The invention provides a multi-source data driving-based north navigation risk space-time evaluation and prediction method, and provides application feasibility and superiority of multi-source heterogeneous earth big data in north navigation risk evaluation and prediction aiming at the problems of data scarcity, incomplete recording and difficult acquisition in north navigation risk evaluation. The uncertainty and the incompleteness of risk information are considered, a fuzzy evidence reasoning method is adopted, objective transformation and integrated processing of risk uncertainty are achieved to the maximum extent, on the basis of risk evaluation, a Markov chain is introduced to conduct risk evolution prediction, and meanwhile, the risk evolution prediction is conducted for the risk sensitivity problem. The multi-scale sensitivity analysis method based on harmonic weight and TOPSIS is provided, multi-disciplinary, multi-dimensional and multi-scale comprehensive evaluation and evolution prediction of the north pole navigation risk are achieved, and the method has the application prospect and value of supporting related risk evaluation and decision product development.

title: Strapdown inertial navigation polar region transverse navigation method improved with ellipsoidal earth model
assignee: NAVAL UNIVERSITY OF ENGINEERING, PLA; 中国人民解放军海军工程大学
abstract_original: The invention relates to a strapdown inertial navigation polar region transverse navigation method improved with an ellipsoidal earth model. According to the method, under an ellipsoidal earth model,polar region transverse navigation becomes a complicated coupling problem. In consideration of the coupling of three-dimensional motion, a more strict improved method for transverse navigation of ellipsoidal earth model is derived anew. Starting from the relationship between Euclidean coordinates and spherical coordinates, the invention derives a polar region transverse navigation equation based on the ellipsoidal earth model in detail. The complete derivation process of attitude, position and velocity calculation is provided. The new derivation process provided by the invention completely avoids solution of the ellipsoidal radius. The numerical result indicates that the transverse navigation method is superior to the traditional method, especially under the vertical movement condition.

title: METHOD FOR MEASURING SHIP MAGNETIC COURSE IN HIGH LATITUDES AND DEVICE FOR ITS IMPLEMENTATION
abstract_original:
FIELD: instrument engineering.
SUBSTANCE: invention relates to the field of navigational instrument making and can be used in high-latitude magnetic compasses, having rolling error due to action on the magnetosensitive element (MSE) of the compass of the vertical component of the Earth's magnetic field, which are equipped with devices for remote transmission of information on the course. Method consists in fact, that generating signal consisting of magnetic course Km, yaw angle γp and systematic error δp from projection of vertical component of terrestrial magnetism, then using angular velocity sensor (AVS) with vertical axis of sensitivity mounted on compass pot, generating a signal proportional to the magnetic course change rate  and yaw  with error  and transmission coefficient KAVS. Signal AVS is integrated and subtracted from magnetic course sensor (MCS) signal in order to generate an error signal δp from influence of projection of vertical component of terrestrial magnetism on rolling. At that, in treatment results there is constant component from error ΔAVS (integrated drift), which is filtered by a high-pass filter with a time constant T2 greater than rolling period, after which from signal MCS subtracting signal proportional to vertical component of terrestrial magnetism δp. Device realizes proposed method and consists of magnetic course sensor MCS, including MSE cartridges and course converter for generation of electric heading signal, located in bowler, on which is installed AVS. MCS is fixed in gimbal suspension, in addition, device has an external indicator with a computing device.
EFFECT: reduced error of magnetic compass on rolling, the value of which is significant in high latitudes.

title: Polar region submarine sound signal transmitter and control method
assignee: HARBIN ENGINEERING UNIVERSITY; 哈尔滨工程大学
abstract_original: The invention discloses a polar region submarine sound signal transmitter and a control method, and belongs to the field of submarine sound signal transmitting equipment. The polar region submarine sound signal transmitter comprises an antenna, an electronic cabin and an energy converter. The antenna is composed of an iridium antenna, a GPS antenna and an antenna box. The iridium antenna is used for receiving remote control data; the GPS antenna is used for receiving positioning data; and the antenna box provides a power and data interface. The electronic cabin is composed of a control cabin,a battery cabin and a power amplification cabin. The control cabin is used for receiving a control command, and generating waveform data; the battery cabin provides the power of the electronic cabin;and the power amplification cabin is used for outputting the power of the signal. According to the transmitter and themethod provided by the invention, the system is extra remotely controlled, and meanwhile the system is artificially controlled on the scene via a Hall switch. The different polar region scientific research test requirements are met.

title: Method for calculating equatorial direction occurrence boundary of L-band ionospheric phase flicker in arctic region
assignee: CHINA INSTITUTE OF RADIO WAVE PROPAGATION (CHINA ELECTRONICS TECHNOLOGY GROUP CORPORATION NO.22 RESEARCH INSTITUTE); 中国电波传播研究所（中国电子科技集团公司第二十二研究所）
abstract_original: The invention discloses an equatorial direction occurrence boundary calculation method for L-band ionospheric phase scintillation in a north pole region. The equatorial direction occurrence boundary calculation method comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting data of a CHAIN ionospheric scintillation monitor and the like; step 2, acquiring latitude and longitude information of the position of the ionospheric scintillation monitor; 3, acquiring a phase flicker index in the vertical direction of the puncture point; step 4, calculating magnetic local time MLT; step 5, dividing the puncture points into grids; step 6, extracting a magnetic weft minimum value; and step 7, obtaining an equatorial direction occurrence boundary suitable for the phase flicker of the L-band ionized layer in the north pole region. According to the calculation method disclosed by the invention, the equatorial direction occurrence boundary of the ionospheric phase flicker in the L frequency band in the arctic region is given by processing the ionospheric flicker observation data in the arctic region.

title: Polar region factor graph construction method and polar region integrated navigation method
assignee: HUAHANG GUIDE CONTROL (TIANJIN) TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.; 华航导控（天津）科技有限公司
abstract_original: The invention provides a polar region factor graph construction method and a polar region integrated navigation method. The polar region factor graph construction method comprises the following steps: 1, constructing a prior factor of a factor graph model according to an initial state of a positioning system; step 2, generating a new factor graph model: adding a GNSS variable factor # imgabs0 # and an IMU variable factor # imgabs1 #, k being a positive integer and representing the kth GNSS variable factor or IMU variable factor, associating adjacent IMU variable factors through IMU factor nodes, and associating the GNSS variable factors with IMU variable factors at the same moment through GNSS factor nodes to generate the new factor graph model; 3, adding corresponding factor nodes according to the variable periods of the variable nodes; and 4, optimizing the new factor graph model: resetting the factor nodes and the variable nodes by the ISAM2 solver according to the new factor graph model and the added variable nodes, and skipping to the step 2. The method can adapt to various complex environments of the polar region, and accurate positioning is carried out.

title: METHOD FOR MEASURING THE MAGNETIC COURSE OF A VESSEL AT HIGH LATITUDES
abstract_original:
FIELD: navigation instrumentation. 
SUBSTANCE: essence of the invention lies in the fact that a micromechanical gyroscope (MMG) is installed on the magnetic compass bowl fixed in a gimbal suspension as an angular velocity sensor with a vertical axis of sensitivity, which generates instantaneous values of angular velocities of course change and yaw. The MMG output data is used to compensate for the values of angular velocities of course change and yaw in the signal generated by differentiating the readings of the compass magnetic heading sensor (MHS). As a result of calculating the difference between the output signals of the differentiating link and the MMG, a signal is formed, which is then passed through a low-pass filter to form a signal proportional to the error at the output of the filter. 
EFFECT: reduction in the pitch error of the compass.

abstract_original: The invention discloses a polar region airport compacted snow runway pavement curing and toughening method, and relates to the technical field of compacted snow runways, and the pavement curing and toughening method comprises the following specific steps: determining the range and length of a compacted snow runway, predicting the use amount of a snow layer according to the range and length of the compacted snow runway, decomposing the snow layer by adopting a manual machine, and carrying out curing and toughening on the surface of the compacted snow runway. The method comprises the steps that a snow layer is conveyed to a compacted snow runway through a conveying vehicle, the snow layer is conveyed to the compacted snow runway through a transfer vehicle, then the snow layer is smashed through a smashing machine to reduce the size of snow particles, wood chips are added for mixing after the snow layer is smashed, and the mixing proportion of the wood chips and the snow is controlled to be 5%-10%, and the method has the advantages that the range and the length of the compacted snow runway are determined, and the usage amount of the snow layer is predicted; the engineering progress can be effectively planned to reduce resource waste, then a snow layer is decomposed manually and mechanically and smashed, the size of snow particles is controlled, a proper amount of wood chips are added to be mixed with the snow layer, the toughness and pressure resistance of the snow layer are improved, and the stability and plasticity of the snow layer are improved.

title: Polar region ice and snow runway and ice and snow runway construction method
assignee: POLAR RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA; 中国极地研究中心
abstract_original: The invention relates to a polar region ice and snow runway and an ice and snow runway construction method. The polar region ice and snow runway comprises ice layers and snow layers, the snow layers are stacked and compacted on the ice layers in a multi-layer mode, a mixing layer is arranged between every two adjacent snow layers, the mixing layers are formed by mixing ice, snow and materials with holes, and the snow layers are watered to form warming layers; the snow layer extends to form snow columns, mixing holes are formed in the mixing layer, the snow columns and the mixing holes are matched in an inserted mode, the mixing layer extends to form mixing columns, snow holes are formed in the snow layer, and the mixing columns and the snow holes are matched in an inserted mode. The snow density is improved in a manual watering and snow warming mode; meanwhile, the mixing layer is clamped between the adjacent snow layers, a material with pores in the mixing layer can form a more stable connecting structure with accumulated snow in the mixing layer and accumulated snow in the adjacent snow layers, and by means of a snow column-mixing hole matching structure and a mixing column-snow hole matching structure, the overall structural strength of the polar region runway is further improved.

title: Artificial snow warming device and method for polar region ice and snow airport construction
assignee: POLAR RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA; 中国极地研究中心
abstract_original: The invention relates to an artificial snow warming device and method for polar region ice and snow airport construction and belongs to the technical field of polar region airport construction. The artificial snow warming device comprises a motor vehicle, a water tank arranged on the motor vehicle, a mechanical arm arranged on the motor vehicle, a spraying table fixed to the mechanical arm and a plurality of sprayers arranged on the spraying table; a water pump and a connecting pipeline are arranged between the water tank and the nozzle, and the water pump is used for feeding water in the water tank into the nozzle through the connecting pipeline; an anti-freezing mechanism is further arranged on the water tank and used for preventing water in the water tank from freezing. title: Construction method of compacted snow runway structure design index system
assignee: RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF HIGHWAY MINISTRY OF TRANSPORT; 交通运输部公路科学研究所
abstract_original: The invention discloses a construction method of a compacted snow runway structure design index system, and relates to the technical field of polar region scientific investigation supporting facilities, and the compacted snow runway structure design index system is divided into compactness, flatness, skid resistance, drainage, durability and safety. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the density and the strength of the snow layer are effectively improved by carrying out manual and mechanical decomposition, sintering and compaction treatment on the natural snow layer, the durability, the skid resistance and the safety of the compacted snow runway are further enhanced, the overall thickness of the compacted snow runway reaches 2 m or above by introducing saw dust and carrying out multiple decomposition, sintering and compaction operations, and the service life of the compacted snow runway is prolonged. The structure stability and the bearing capacity of the runway are ensured, and in the detection and improvement stage of the compacted snow runway, a measuring instrument is used for evaluating various indexes of the compacted snow runway, including the compactness, the flatness, the skid resistance, the drainage performance, the durability and the safety, so that the quality and the safety of the runway are ensured.

title: DEVICE FOR CREATION OF SNOW-ICE COVER OF AIRFIELDS ON ICE SURFACES OF THE FAR NORTH
abstract_original:
FIELD: construction.
SUBSTANCE: invention relates to the field of construction of snow-ice coverings of aerodromes and can be used for the construction of aerodromes in the polar regions of the planet, where there are zones of cover glaciers (Antarctica, Arctic islands), as well as on long-term floating pack ice of the Arctic. Device for creation of snow-ice cover of airfields on ice surfaces of the Far North includes trailed rectangular frame containing four rigidly connected to each other metal beams of U-shaped equal-flange profile, two of which are located transversely to the axis of movement, and the other two are located longitudinally to the axis of movement. Wherein crosswise channels are secured on lengthwise channels so that wall of every channel is coupled with flange of every crosswise channel. Device contains cutting-loosening elements, which are pieces of metal beams of L-shaped equal-flange profile with flanges sharpened in lower part, rigidly fixed with equal pitch on wall of rear transverse channel so that one of flanges of angle is conjugated with wall of rear transverse channel, and lower sharpened edge of angle extends downwards beyond lower surface of longitudinal channels. Front ends of the longitudinal channels are pointed upwards.
EFFECT: invention provides reduction of labour and power consumption for creation of snow-ice cover of airfields in zone of cover glaciers and possibility of creation of snow-ice cover, characterized by increased operational period of runway in summer season.

title: Manual sintering method for polar region ice and snow airport construction
assignee: POLAR RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA; 中国极地研究中心
abstract_original: The invention relates to a manual sintering method for polar region ice and snow airport construction. The method comprises the following steps that: S1, ice layer crushing is performed, specifically, a crushing device crushes an original ice layer, sawdust is added into the ice layer by a material mixing assembly, and the crushed ice layer is mixed with snowfall by a uniform mixing assembly until ice and snow are uniformly mixed to form an ice and snow layer; S2, mechanical compaction is carried out, specifically the mixed ice layer is compacted; S3, the ice and snow layer is heated by using a heating assembly; S4, an ice surface is polished, specifically the ice surface is polished by using a polishing assembly; S5, watering and maintaining are performed,specifically and a spraying assembly is used for spraying water to the ice surface. The method can improve the hardness of the airport runway.

title: Floating floor structure in north pole region
assignee: BOMESC OFFSHORE ENGINEERING COMPANY LIMITED; 博迈科海洋工程股份有限公司
abstract_original: The utility model discloses a floating floor structure in the Arctic region, which comprises a steel plate laid on a construction surface along the horizontal direction, the steel plate and the construction surface are bonded and fixed through structural adhesive, the peripheral side walls of the steel plate are fixedly connected with the inner wall of a cabin, a rock wool layer is laid on the steel plate, and the rock wool layer is arranged on the steel plate. According to the utility model, the strength of the LNG module cabin floor can be enhanced and floor condensation can be reduced in the Arctic region.

title: Method for increasing friction coefficient of polar region ice and snow runway pavement
assignee: POLAR RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA (CHINESE POLE REGION INSTITUTE); 中国极地研究中心（中国极地研究所）
abstract_original: The invention discloses a method for increasing the friction coefficient of a polar region ice and snow runway pavement, and relates to the field of ice and snow airport construction.The method comprises the steps that a hardened snow layer on the surface of an undisturbed snow layer is smashed and collected, then the undisturbed snow layer is rolled to form a compacted snow layer, and finally grooves used for increasing roughness are carved in the surface of the compacted snow layer; meanwhile, the collected hardened snow layer is smashed into a paving material or mixed with wood chips to form mixed powder, snow is warmed on the surface of the lower layer of the compacted snow layer, and the hardened snow layer particles or the mixed powder is laid on the surface of the lower layer of the compacted snow layer to form a pavement of the upper surface layer of the compacted snow layer runway. title: Preparation method of wide bandgap oxide Schottky junction beta nuclear battery unit
assignee: XI'AN ELECTRONIC SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY UNIVERSITY TURNIP RESEARCH INSTITUTE; 西安电子科技大学芜湖研究院
abstract_original: The invention belongs to the technical field of semiconductor devices and nuclear science, and particularly relates to a preparation method of a wide bandgap oxide Schottky junction beta nuclear battery unit, which comprises the following steps of: growing an n-type beta-Ga2O3 texture film on a substrate through a two-step hydrothermal method; after high-temperature annealing, the Ga2O3-based Schottky diode unit is assembled with a graphene or carbon nanotube or metal Ti/Au film top electrode to obtain a Ga2O3-based Schottky diode unit; and finally, an ultrathin 63Ni radiation source thin film is attached to the Ga2O3-based Schottky diode unit to obtain the wide-bandgap oxide Schottky junction beta-radiovolt nuclear battery. The prepared beta-radiovolt nuclear battery provides a reliable power supply capable of continuously supplying power without depending on external input energy for extremely severe environments such as deep space, deep sea and polar regions. The energy band structure of the wide bandgap semiconductor is controlled by doping metal elements, and the growth form of the wide bandgap semiconductor is regulated and controlled by using a surfactant, so that the growth form of the wide bandgap semiconductor and the energy band structure of the wide bandgap semiconductor are regulated and controlled.

title: Wind power generation equipment and yaw control method thereof

abstract_original: The invention discloses wind power generation equipment and a yaw control method thereof. The wind power generation equipment comprises a power generation system, a control and energy storage system and a yaw system which are connected with one another, the power generation system comprises an acceleration vortex tube, a rectifying device and at least two fans, the rectifying device is installed in the acceleration vortex tube and located in front of the fans, and the at least two fans are installed in the acceleration vortex tube at intervals in the length direction of the acceleration vortex tube; and the control and energy storage system is used for storing the electric energy generated by the power generation system and is used for controlling the yaw system to yaw to drive the power generation system to rotate under a preset condition. title: Solar heat absorption and storage heat preservation tent based on phase change heat storage material technology
assignee: CHINA UNIVERSITY OF GEOSCIENCES (BEIJING); 中国地质大学（北京）
abstract_original: The invention discloses a solar heat absorption and storage heat preservation tent based on a phase change heat storage material technology, and belongs to the related field of outdoor sports equipment. The phase-change energy storage tent structurally comprises double-layer tent cloth, a tent supporting structure and a phase-change energy storage unit from inside to outside as shown in the attached drawing. In actual use, an oxygen supply device and a heat insulation pad can be added, and the comfort and safety of resting of people are guaranteed. Wherein the double-layer tarpaulin is internally supported, externally hung and fixed, the outer-layer tarpaulin is made of polyester cloth, and the inner-layer tarpaulin is made of PVC cloth. Through the top opening of the outer-layer tarpaulin and the bottom opening of the inner-layer tarpaulin, heat convection is used for ventilation; the phase change energy storage unit is located on the outer layer tarpaulin and fixed through hot melting. The phase change energy storage unit can absorb solar energy to generate heat, and the temperature in the tent is adjusted. The invention has wide application value in improving the living environment of operating personnel in plateau, polar region and other regions, saving tent energy such as kerosene, efficiently utilizing solar energy and reducing carbon emission.

title: COMPLEX AND METHOD FOR CONDUCTING MARINE SYNCHRONOUS ENGINEERING AND OIL AND GAS SEISMIC SURVEYS
abstract_original:
FIELD: geology.
SUBSTANCE: invention relates to technology for conducting marine seismic surveys to solve geological exploration problems, as well as to search for and classify hazardous geological processes and phenomena at the early stages of preparation for exploration and production drilling in offshore promising areas, including deposits in the Arctic region. The claimed solution involves the use of seismic inversion in several frequency ranges. The quality of seismic data interpretation for the purpose of identifying exploration targets is improved by taking into account inhomogeneities in the upper part of the geological section. The range of weather conditions suitable for performing engineering and geophysical surveys is expanded in the claimed proposal by deepening seismic-acoustic systems and applying procedures to compensate for the influence of the “water-air” free surface during broadband processing.
EFFECT: invention enables: reduction of time costs from the stage of 2D seismic surveys on licensed areas to drilling an exploration/production well; increasing the reliability of predicting drilling complications and the detail of constructing geomechanical models along the wellbore, as well as reducing the negative anthropogenic impact on marine mammals.

abstract_original: The invention discloses a soil ecological restoration technology for a photovoltaic power generation area, and relates to the field of soil ecological restoration. The ecological restoration technology for the soil in the photovoltaic power generation area comprises the steps of propagule acquisition, propagule inoculation and field cultivation of biological crust. The moss biological crust is an organic complex formed by bonding unique and dense rhizoids of bryophytes capable of growing in extremely severe environments (such as stony desertification, desertification, polar regions and the like) with surface soil particles in an advanced stage of biological crust succession forward succession. title: Combined pulse high-power semiconductor laser therapeutic instrument driving device

abstract_original: The invention discloses a combined pulse high-power semiconductor laser therapeutic instrument driving device. The driving device comprises a pulse modulation circuit, an MOS transistor, a feedback amplification circuit, a power supply Power, a laser diode and a current amplification circuit. title: Wastewater treatment device based on bipolar membrane electrodialysis
assignee: BEIJING JIAOTONG UNIVERSITY; 北京交通大学
abstract_original: The utility model provides a wastewater treatment device based on bipolar membrane electrodialysis. And the generated strong brine is recycled by the bipolar membrane electrodialysis system, so that the recycling of salt is realized. The device is powered by a solar power supply system.

title: METHOD FOR TESTING SHIP MODELS IN EXPERIMENTAL ICE POOL
abstract_original:
FIELD: shipbuilding.
SUBSTANCE: methods for testing models of ice-navigating vessels in a pool with artificial ice. Positively buoyant particles made of high-pressure polyethylene in the form of truncated cones are placed into the water and the surface layer of water is cooled until an ice field is formed, after which the value of the ice resistance of the vessel is determined by moving its model along the ice field. In order to ensure unconditional floating of the cone axis vertically upward, a blind hole is made in polyethylene particles along the axis of the cone from the lower base upwards, which is tightly closed in the lower part with a cylindrical plug made of heavy metal. The diameter of the hole, its height from the base, and the mass of the plug are selected such that two conditions are met. The first is that the mass of a conical polyethylene particle with a hole and a heavy plug is equal to the mass of the same particle without a hole and a plug, i.e. the average density of the volume of a truncated cone with a hole and a plug is equal to the density of the polyethylene from which the truncated cone is made. This condition ensures that the proposed cone design is physically identical to a cone without a hole and a plug. The second condition is that the center of gravity of the truncated cone modified in the described manner is located below the center of application of buoyancy forces when the cone is vertically positioned with the large base upward.
EFFECT: reduction in the labor intensity of preparing model ice is achieved.

abstract_original: The invention relates to a risk assessment method and system for safe navigation of a ship, and the method comprises the following steps: risk perception: obtaining the original data of the natural environment of a polar region, and carrying out the preprocessing; performing risk cognition: performing systematic analysis on risk influence factors of the navigation ship in the polar region water area by applying a system theory accident model and process, taking the risk influence factors as nodes, obtaining a transition rate between the nodes according to the preprocessed original data, and constructing a random Petri network model; risk control: sorting the nodes in the model according to the steady-state probability by using a Markov chain, and carrying out risk control processing on the nodes with low steady-state probability; and risk decision-making: generating an air route and a risk control scheme in the polar navigation water area. According to the method, the informatization technology is adopted to perceive risk factors to reveal polar region environment space features, the complex system safety theory is applied to research polar region water area ship navigation risks, and precise risk cognition is achieved by combining subjective and objective data fusion.

title: Great circle route distance calculation method

abstract_original: The invention belongs to the field of flight management system design, and relates to a great circle route distance calculation improved method, which comprises the following steps of: 1, establishingan ellipsoidal surface O-for the earth; an XYZ coordinate system; 2) calculating corresponding radiuses R1 and R2 of a starting point P1 and a terminating point P2 of a navigation segment under the ellipsoidal coordinate system; (3) obtaining coordinate vectors of the starting point P1 and the ending point P2 under the ellipsoidal coordinate system according to the corresponding radiuses R1 and R2 of the starting point P1 and the ending point P2 under the ellipsoidal coordinate system; (4), solving a radian included angle [omega] of the point P1 and the point P2 by means of cross multiplication according to the coordinate vectors of the ellipsoidal surfaces of the starting point P1 and the ending point P2; (5) solving a median radius; and (6) calculating the distance D from the starting point P1 to the ending point P2. title: Method and system for aligning local and astronomical time in celestial clocks
assignee: Charles A. G. Gugino
abstract_original: The present invention is a digital timekeeping system that integrates standard civil time with real-time astronomical data, including sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset. Utilizing ephemeris calculations, the system dynamically adjusts a 360° clockface to reflect varying day and night lengths based on the user's geographic location and date. Sunrise is anchored at left and sunset at right, dividing the clockface into equal and distinct daytime and nighttime arcs. Hour indices are proportionally spaced to represent actual daylight and darkness durations, creating intuitive time visualization. Sun and moon indicators traverse the dial, positioning themselves in the upper semicircle when above the horizon and in the lower semicircle when below. This solution adapts to diverse geographic conditions, including polar regions, providing an intuitive representation of celestial movements alongside conventional timekeeping. The invention uniquely aligns standard time with celestial observations, offering users a precise visual depiction of time integrated with natural astronomical cycles.

title: DEVICE FOR DETERMINING COURSE
abstract_original:
FIELD: aircraft construction.
SUBSTANCE: on-board flight control and navigation equipment of aircraft in which the heading measurement system is the main navigation means. To determine the course of an aircraft according to this invention, the initial alignment of the gyroscopic heading system is carried out in flight according to the difference between the track angle determined by the satellite navigation system and the drift angle determined by the Doppler meter of the components of the aircraft's speed relative to the Earth's surface. After the initial alignment, the aircraft's course is determined by a signal from the gyroscopic heading system, which is integrated using a Kalman filter using signals from a Doppler meter for the components of the aircraft's speed relative to the Earth's surface, the air signal system and the satellite navigation system.
EFFECT: increase in the accuracy and reliability of course determination in high latitudes, a reduction in the weight and size characteristics of on-board flight navigation equipment.

title: Comprehensive correction method for marine grid inertial navigation system
assignee: HARBIN ENGINEERING UNIVERSITY; 哈尔滨工程大学
abstract_original: The invention discloses a comprehensive correction method for a marine grid inertial navigation system, belongs to the technical field of inertial navigation systems. The method comprises the following steps of firstly making the system operate in an external horizontal damping working state with the aid of an external speed device such as a Doppler log, where the system works in the external horizontal damping working state when the position and grid heading reference cannot be provided from the outside; resetting the system with the aid of first external information when the discontinuous position and the grid heading reference can be provided from the outside, completing the accurate estimation of the gyro constant drift in the carrier coordinate system according to derived equations, equations and comprehensive correction strategies when second external information arrives, compensating the gyro constant drift and completing second system resetting to complete the comprehensive correction process. The feasibility of the designed two-point calibration correction algorithm in practical applications is verified by the semi-physical simulation results, which can effectively ensurethe navigation accuracy of the ship in the polar region.

title: Satellite network route determination method and device, equipment and storage medium
assignee: PENG CHENG LABORATORY; 鹏城实验室
abstract_original: The invention discloses a satellite network route determination method and device, equipment and a storage medium. A starting satellite is determined according to position information of a source satellite; determining the number of times that the starting point satellite needs to pass through a high-latitude area to reach a target orbit through the different-orbit inter-satellite link, wherein the target orbit is a satellite orbit corresponding to the target satellite; determining path parameters from the source satellite to the target satellite according to the crossing times; and determining a path transmission cost based on the path parameter, and determining routing information according to the path transmission cost and the path parameter. The method comprises the following steps: determining path parameters of a source satellite to a target satellite according to the crossing times of a high-latitude region required to be crossed when a starting satellite reaches a target orbit through a different-orbit inter-satellite link; and determining a path transmission cost based on the path parameter, and determining routing information according to the path transmission cost and the path parameter. Compared with an existing mode of storing multiple routing tables corresponding to different time slices on the satellite, the method and the device have the advantages that the consumption of satellite resources can be reduced, and the routing determination efficiency is improved.

title: Kalman filtering-based horizontal coordinate system strapdown inertial navigation system damping algorithm
assignee: HARBIN ENGINEERING UNIVERSITY; 哈尔滨工程大学
abstract_original: The invention provides a kalman filtering-based horizontal coordinate system strapdown inertial navigation system damping algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of polar region navigation. A kalman filtering error model in the horizontal coordinate system is established, a horizontal attitude error angle is estimated, and the horizontal attitude error angle is continuously corrected by means of feedback correction, so that Schuler oscillation in posture, speed and position errors is inhibited, and outer horizontal damping of the kalman filtering is realized. The reliability of the outerspeed information is judged according to the outer speed validity criterion; and the running state of the current strapdown inertial navigation system is determined according to the judgment result,and when the outer speed information is effective, the system switches from the non-damping state to the damping state; finally, after the kalman filtering is stable, the estimated horizontal attitudeerror angle is continuously fed back and corrected, so that that Schuler oscillation in posture, speed and position errors is inhibited, and outer horizontal damping of the polar region kalman filtering is realized. According to the algorithm, the outer horizontal damping of the polar region can be realized, and the overshoot error generated in the damping switching process also can be inhibited.

abstract_original: The invention relates to a method for reducing the positioning drift of a Beidou positioning terminal at stopping of a vehicle. The method is simple; and the positioning data are accurate.

title: METHOD FOR POWER SUPPLY AND ASSEMBLY OF FACILITIES IN EXTREME CONDITIONS AND AIR MOBILE UNIT FOR IMPLEMENTATION THEREOF
abstract_original:
FIELD: power engineering.
SUBSTANCE: group of inventions relates to power units installed on aircrafts. The method of power supply and assembly of facilities in extreme conditions includes supply of electrical and thermal energy to the ground/surface facility through a communication line from an external source and transportation of the mounted structure on an external suspension. The external energy source is a nuclear power unit with a power control system and biosecurity. The means of production of construction and assembly operations are delivered without delay to a predetermined location on the air mobile unit. The air mobile unit is comprised of a body with sections filled with carrier gas and air heated from a nuclear power unit, a nuclear power unit, a power control system, a heat-to-electricity converter and heat exchangers, a crew cabin, residential and technical premises, a cargo transportation unit on an external suspension, supporting systems, engines, rudders, mooring and fixing apparatuses. The air mobile unit is comprised of a normally folded communication line for transmission of electrical and thermal energy from the nuclear power unit to an external consumer, mechanisms for unfolding and folding the communication line; a cab of the hoisting mechanism operator and means of production of construction and assembly operations. 
EFFECT: group of inventions is designed to ensure survivability of remote facilities in the Arctic and the Far North in the event of problems with power supply at the facilities and conduction of construction and assembly operations in hard-to-reach and remote areas.
